title: Void Sword
description: Too easy worlds? Check this mod!
body:
### Your worlds are too easy?
### You want to be op by exploring?
## Great for you!
**Void Sword** implements a new sword that will **change your world**! This sword can make any creature **die INSTANTLY**! (Even the Warden or a player with **full netherite**)
But its **not** so easy, you have to trade constantly with a **weaponsmith** until you unlock the trade, then you have to get **64 emeralds and 8 netherite** to finnaly get **1 Void Ingot**, now you gotta craft 1 void ingot, **1 netherite and 1 stick together** (like a sword) to get the **Void Sword**! (its a long time to get it, so be prepared to do it)

For any issues just send a mail to:
